title: New Free 3D AI Generator from Tencent Might Be the Best Yet
author: Delicious-Shower8401

comments.author: Opening_Apricot_5419
comments.body: The model's accuracy looks quite high. Can it be directly imported into Blender or UE5?

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: I'm continuing my nightmare of building an environment but usually with AI generated models the topology will be excessively expensive and poorly optimized.

replies.author: Kindly_Life_947
replies.body: there is the option to retopo and generate level of details. I wrote a script that does it automatically on blender. Quality is not the same compared to if you use 2 weeks by hand making something, but the speed quality difference out weights the quality issues IMO

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body: When people show off these 3D generators they never zoom in or show the mesh. Nearly all these 3D gens look good from a distance now, it's only when you get closer when you start seeing how bad it is.

replies.author: imnotabot303
replies.body:
You're just proving my point the topology is awful. People need to stop hyping up these 3D generators like they make models ready to just drop into a game. They don't, and it just fools people with no 3D knowledge or skills. That's of course unless you're happy with sloppy un-optimised meshes and textures.

Nearly all 3D gens I've tried produce models on par with photogrammetry or 3D scans that have been stuck through a mesh decimate. They all need manual work both with topology and texture rebaking.

comments.author: Still_Ad9431
comments.body: Wake me up when they have text to retopology or text to UV mapping

comments.author: Neither_Bluebird_795
comments.body: How many tries did that take ?? It’s free !? 👀
